figures.caption_plain: Ownership ablation on nine fixed input/arrival scenarios. Panels show cohort and brief completion ratios Full C1/Full C0; F, I and B denote front, interleaved and back arrivals. Each open point is one matched process block (four per row); diamonds are geometric means and horizontal segments span observed minima to maxima, not confidence intervals. Blue row bands identify interleaving; alternating group shading separates the three input pairs. The dashed line is equality. Both axes are logarithmic; values below one favour Full C1.

figures.caption_plain: Fair baseline comparison on the 7B model. Rows identify the comparator; each cell is Adaptive/comparator for one quota and fixed input family, with cohort time above and brief completion below. The printed value is the geometric mean of four matched process ratios. Each cell also retains the four open raw points and their observed range using the same equality-centred log2 glyph scale; its dotted mark is one. Values below and above one each occupy half of the shared colour/glyph scale. Colour is centred on equality: blue favours Adaptive and ochre favours the comparator. The outlined instruction 4x-quota cohort cell retains Adaptive/Hard reserve = 1.031. All adverse cells are retained. These are observed ranges, not confidence intervals; two fixed input families are not independent workload samples. Full-precision displayed groups and all original method-pair contrasts accompany the figure.

figures.caption_plain: Fresh-input 4x-quota scheduling ledger, with prefix and instruction inputs shown in stacked panels. Left: mean cohort wall time over six matched balanced process blocks, split into the recorded scheduling interval and the arithmetic remainder; all 36 original total-time endpoints are retained as open points. Right: scheduling milliseconds per invocation for the same runs, with each arm mean printed above its six raw points on a logarithmic axis. Segments span observed ranges, not confidence intervals. Reuse off/on share the same policy. The remainder is not measured GPU time and recorded scheduling is not an irreducible certificate lower bound.
